name: jobtread
description: Connect JobTread to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use JobTread MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect JobTread to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with construction job management using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my JobTread workspace.
Find anything in JobTread that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review construction job management in JobTread.
